question: For a D-2-5 research student applying at an embassy, which documents can prove financial ability, and who has to submit the original final education document?
reference: An original document proving financial ability, such as a bank statement or a receipt of research allowance (a family relation certificate is also needed if a parent's bank statement is used). The original document showing the final level of education is required only for those who have earned a master's degree or higher.
answer: For a D-2-5 research student applying at an embassy, documents that can prove financial ability include a bank statement or a receipt of research allowance [1]. The original copy of the document indicating the final level of education must be submitted by those who earned a master's degree or higher [1].

A person who plans to engage in a specific research at a college, undergraduate/graduate college established in accordance with Higher Education Act, or a college established in accordance with the Special Act

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to engage in research activities at an academic research institute, or a community college or above, established in accordance with the Higher Education Act or Special Act

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate (or Registration Number Certificate) of a respective education institute
③ Documents proving your engagement in the research activities
④ Original copy of document indicating the final level of education (for those who earned master’s degree or higher)
⑤ Original copy of document proving your financial ability to support yourself (i.e. bank statement, a receipt of research allowance)
- When submitting a parent's bank statement, family relation certificate is required to submit.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: What must a foreign company have imported for its production employees to be eligible for the D-3-13 industrial trainee (plant) visa?
reference: Industrial facilities or plants worth US$500,000 or more, with the employee needing job training to manage those facilities or plants.
answer: A foreign company must have imported industrial facilities or plants worth US$500,000 or more for its production employees to be eligible for the D-3-13 industrial trainee (plant) visa [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-3-13 Industrial Trainee (Plant)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in training at an entity which exports industrial facilities(plants) in accordance with the Foreign Trade Act

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An production employee of a foreign company that has imported industrial facilities or plants worth of US$500,000 or more, and who is deemed to require receiving job training to manage the facilities or plants

[ Trainee Requirements ]
1. A healthy person aged between 18 and 40 2. More than 3 months of working experience at the Korean subsidiary
2. More than 3 months working experience at a local subsidiary
3. Acquiring second-level or higher, or score of 50 out of 200 on TOPIK (excluding those who have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Korea, or who plans to receive training at the corporation that has signed a pledge to implement Korean language education 5 hours or more per month, and hire a full-time translator per 100 trainees)

### Required documents
1. Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
2. Documents proving an invitee has met requirements for being an industrial trainee
① A copy of Business Registration Certificate of the branch office located in an applicant's country (or a charter)
② Invitee’s Employment Certificate issued by the head of a branch office and a copy of passport.
③ Documents proving sufficiency in Korean
※ if there is a Korean diplomatic mission in an applicant's country, ① and ② need to be authenticated by consular officers
3. A training course plan that can confirm the details of training schedule. (Refer to Archive)
4. A letter of guarantee from inviter
※ If there are two principle debtors or more, you can submit one reference letter with an enclosed “Invitee List” on the confirmation of visa issuance.
5. Documents proving that the host company is a permitted corporation as a Plant export business
- An approval for a plant export (including an approval for amendment)
6. Documents proving the number of full time employees of the host company in order to determine the permitted number of accepting trainees
- You need to submit a statement of insurance qualification printed out from the website of the Ministry of Employment and Labor (Employment Insurance website)
7. Documents demonstrating the on-the-job training facilities such as photos of dormitory for more details of training or housing facilities.

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

question: Which organisation's recommendation letter does a D-4-5 Korean cuisine trainee chef need?
reference: A recommendation letter from the Agriculture and Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation of Korea (aT).
answer: A D-4-5 Korean cuisine trainee chef needs a recommendation letter from the Agriculture and Fisheries ＆ Food Trade Corporation of ROK (aT) [1].

A person who plans to receive a training related to Korean cuisine at a Korean cooking academy designated by the Minister of Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MIFAFF)

### Eligibility
You are eligible for this visa if you are

A person who plans to receive a training related to Korean cuisine at a cooking academy in ROK which has been designated by the Minister of Food, Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MIFAFF)

question: my companys overseas branch is sending me to the head office in seoul on a D-7-2 visa. does the dispatch order need to say anything specific, and do we have to hand in the HQ corporate register?
reference: The dispatch order must indicate the period of the overseas assignment. A certified copy of the headquarters' unabridged Corporate Register is required, but you may be exempt from it if your company is a public corporation.
answer: The dispatch order must indicate the period of the overseas assignment [1]. You may be exempt from submitting the certified copy of the unabridged Corporate Register of the headquarter if your company is a public corporation [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-7-2 Intra-Company Transferee (Domestic Company)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who has worked for at least 1 year or more at an overseas corporation or branch of a public organization or a listed company, and is dispatched to headquaters or head office in ROK for training or teaching professional knowledge·technology

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A foreign worker who plans to work at the headquarter office in the Republic of Korea and who was initially employed by the overseas office of the Korean company.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document demonstrating that you are an indispensable professional specialist (i.e. resume, a certificate of employment history and others)
③ A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register of the headquarter (you may be exempt from submitting this document, if your company is a public corporation)
④ Foreign Direct Investment Declaration or Overseas Branch Office Establishment Declaration
⑤ A document proving international wire transfer
⑥ A copy of business registration certificate or a certified copy of Corporate Register(unabridged) of the overseas branch office
⑦ A proof of employment or a tax payment receipt
⑧ A dispatch order(It should indicate the period of the overseas assignment.)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: Which documents does the D-9-3 shipbuilding technician guide list for an embassy application?
reference: The visa application form (Form No. 17), passport, a standard photo and the fee; a copy of the trade contract; a dispatch order; a copy of the inviting company's Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of its unabridged Corporate Register; and a certificate of annual tax payment.

question: For an E-3 researcher applying through Confirmation of Visa Issuance, what kind of visa is issued and what is the maximum period of stay?
reference: A multiple-entry visa valid for the period of stay, and the stay is granted for up to 5 years.
answer: For an E-3 researcher applying through Confirmation of Visa Issuance (CCVI), a multiple-entry visa is issued [1]. The maximum period of stay granted is up to 5 years [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: E-3 Researcher
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in research and development of advanced industrial technology or natural science field at research laboratories upon invitation by a Korean public/private institute in ROK [However, a person who falls under the E-1 Professor status is excluded]

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A scientist who plans to engage in natural science research or highly advanced industrial technology at a research center defined in the provisions of the Support of Specific Research Institutes Act or Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-funded Research Institutions.

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A document relevant to the establishment of a host institute
- A copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register
③ A degree certificate or a certificate of employment history
④ An employment contract

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for your period of stay.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 5 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A scientist who plans to work at following organizations or associations in order to research and develop natural science sector or highly advanced industrial technology in accordance with the Industrial Technology Innovation Promotion Act or other relevant acts
- A corporate-affiliated research center
- An industry technological research union in accordance with the Act on the Support of Industrial Technology Research Cooperatives
- A university or community college in accordance with the Higher Education Act
- A national/public research institute
- A public institution for a technical assistance in accordance with the Industrial Technology Innovation Promotion Act
- A non-profit research institute for science and technology established in accordance with the Civil Act or other laws
- Other science and technology research institutes or profit-oriented corporations

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A document relevant to the establishment of a host institute
- A copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register
③ A degree certificate or a certificate of employment history
④ An employment contract

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for your period of stay.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 5 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person recommended by the Minister of the Education, Science and Technology and who wants to work at government-funded research institutes, national/public research center, corporate research institutes and other research institutes for natural science or highly advanced industrial technology

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A document relevant to the establishment of a host institute
- A copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register
③ An employment contract, or confirmation of prospective employment
④ An employment recommendation from the Minister of Education, Science and Technology of ROK
- If you wish to work in Korean Free Economic Zone, you must submit an employment recommendation letter or a document proving the necessity of employment issued by the respective mayor or provincial governor.

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for your period of stay.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 5 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 4

question: What kinds of performers does the E-6-2 hotel and adult entertainment visa cover, and what visa validity and period of stay are granted?
reference: People who perform or do entertainment activities at a hotel or an adult entertainment business defined in the Tourism Promotion Act, such as pop musicians, instrument players, circus artists or magicians. question: For an F-1-23 household assistant visa applied for at an embassy, what must the foreign investor employer's investment and company look like?
reference: The investor must have invested $100,000 or more in a high-tech information business and hold D-8, F-2 or F-5 status, and must be a CEO or executive of a high-tech company with at least three Korean full-time workers.
answer: The foreign investor must have invested $100,000 or more in high-tech information business and acquired a status of stay as a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), Resident (F-2), or Permanent Resident (F-5) [1]. The employer must be the CEO or an executive of a high-tech company with at least three Korean full-time workers [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: F-1-23 Household assistant of high-tech investor
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to work for an advanced technology investor as a household assistant under contract with him/her

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a foreign investor who has invested $100,000 or more in high tech information business and acquired a status of stay of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8), a Resident (F-2), or a Permanent Resident (F-5)
※ The person must have been employed for at least 1 year by the same employer in other countries.
※ A foreign investor must be a CEO or an executive of a high tech company with at least three Korean full-time workers.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A Foreign Investment Notification form (A certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register or a copy of Business Registration Certificate ) or a copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Venture (D-8-2) and Technology and Business Startup (D-8-4), Business venture confirmation or a prospective venture confirmation
※ If you are a visa holder of Business Startup (D-8-4), you must submit documents proving industrial property rights and other certificates to prove the rights to technology and other copyrights
③ An employer's proof of employment (i.e. certificate of identification)
④ A document proving the income status of the employer
- A receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook
※ The employer's income should be three times more than gross national income (GNI) of the previous year announced by the Bank of Korea
⑤ A document proving a company is hiring Korean full-time workers (for those whose investment is worth less than US $500,000)
※ e.g. receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate indicating the amount of income, payslip, a copy of bankbook
⑥ An employment contract of household assistant
⑦ A letter of guarantee
⑧ A document proving a level of education of the household employee
⑨ A document proving that the household assistant has been hired by the employer for at least one year
※ e.g. Employment contract, payslip, a copy of bankbook

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

passages.snippet:
<붙임2>
(제1쪽 / Page1)
결혼 배경 진술서 (Personal Details Form for F-2-3 Visa)
<유의사항>
이 질문지는 영주자격 소지자의 배우자(F-2-3) 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 신청하는 신청인이 작성합니다. 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 신청인께서는 가능한 모든 질문에 답변하고, 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사 시 참고할 수 있도록 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다. 답변이 누락되거나 입증서류가 제출되지 않는 경 우 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
만약 허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건입증에 필요한 서류를 갖추지 못하였음에도 요건을 충족한 것으로 보이기 위해 허위의 사실을 기재하거나 위조된 서류를 제출하는 것은 관련 법령에 의거 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입국이 금지될 수 있습니다.
요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류를 갖추지 못하였다면, 그 사유를 기재한 사유서를 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
귀하가 제공하신 정보는 개인정보 보호법에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따른 업무에만 활용됩니다.
<NOTE>
This form is to be completed by a person applying for a marriage visa(F-2-3). In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form. Therefore, the questions must be answered to the best of the applicant's knowledge and submit any relevant documentation that can be provided to the consul or the immigration officer as reference. If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the evaluation process for the application may be delayed or disapproved.
If conditions are not met for the visa or if falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant Act but also banned from entering the Republic of Korea. If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason.
The information you provide in this form will be protected according to the Personal Information Protection Law, and will only be used for matters governed by the Immigration Act. 1. 인적사항 / PERSONAL INFORMATION
1.1 여권에 기재된 성명 / Your full name (as shown in your passport)
성 / Famliy name 명 / Given name
1.2 성별 / Sex [ ] 남 / Male [ ] 여 / Female
1.3 현지 언어로 성명을 기재하시오 / Your full name written in your native language 성 / Famliy name 명 / Given name
1.4 과거에 다른 이름을 사용하였던 적이 있습니까?(있다면 그 이름과 변경한 이유를 기재하시오 / Do you have other names you have been known by?(If yes, write the names and explain why you changed the names)
[ ] 예 / Yes [ ] 아니오 / No

question: im ethnic korean living in china and got picked in the work and visit visa lottery. for the H-2-5 visa itself, what proof of winning do i bring to the consulate, and how long is the visa good for?
reference: Bring the receipt of application or a printout of the Winner's Card for the lottery. The H-2-5 visa is multiple-entry and valid for 3 years, and the first period of stay is granted for up to 1 year.
answer: For the H-2-5 visa, you must bring a printout of your Winner's Card for Lottery as proof of winning [1]. The visa itself is valid for 3 years [1].

question: A retired Chinese immigrant investor over 55 is applying for a C-3-1 visa through Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Case 2). What proof of assets is needed?
reference: Documents showing financial assets worth at least 300 million KRW, such as deposits or real estate.
answer: For a retired immigrant investor over 55 applying for a C-3-1 visa through Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Case 2), proof of assets worth at least 300 million KRW is needed [1]. This includes deposits and assets such as real estate [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: C-3-1 Short-Term General
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to stay for a short period of time on the purpose of visiting relatives, investing in public business, participating in a non-official sport games, attending events or meetings, performing cultural art, engaging in a training, taking lessons, attending a religious ceremony, collecting documents for academic research, or any other equivalent activities.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A foreign investor, or an executive and a stockholder of a corporate that has invested a substantial amount of capital in the investment facilities, and who wishes to frequently travel to the ROK without alien registration, and his/her accompanied family members (parents, a spouse, children, parents-in-law)

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② Certified copy of real estate register, a real-estate contract (for a person registered)
③ Membership certificate confirmed and issued by the Korea Leisure Condominium Management Association, membership certificate and deposit receipt issued by the selling company (for members only)
④ Certificate of foreign exchange purchase (a receipt of wire transfer to ROK, proof of money transfer or other documents indicating that you have brought foreign capitals to ROK)
⑤ Additional document to prove payment or remittance from overseas (under corresponding investor’s name) to the corporate
⑥ Official letter from the respective company, which indicates that you are a member of their current executive body or oligopolistic stockholder. You also need the entire list of their executives and stockholders (for executives or stockholders of the company only)
⑦ A certificate of family relations (only when you apply for accompanying family)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A retired foreign investor, or an executive or a stockholder of a corporate that has invested a substantial amount of capital in the investment target designated by the Minister of Justice, and who wishes to frequently travel to the ROK without alien registration, and his/her accompanied family members (parents, a spouse, children, parents-in-law)

#### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② Any documents proving that you have paid an applicant's investment money (investment confirmation stamped by the head of an investment-attracting agency, wire transfer receipt, and etc.)
③ A document demonstrating foreign exchange purchase or a record of capitals inflow to ROK for business operation, or a record of fund being wire-transferred to ROK.
④ Family Relations Certificate (limited to a case where spouse of investor or minor children, parents apply for the visa)
⑤ For Retired immigrant investors(over age 55), documents demonstrating their financial assets worth at least 300 million KRW (i.e. deposits, assets such as real estate)
⑥ Official letter from the respective company, which indicates that you are a member of their current executive body or oligopolistic stockholder. You also need the entire list of their executives and stockholders (for executives or stockholders of the company only)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: On a D-4-2 general trainee visa, which application route does a trainee invited by the Ministry of National Defense use compared with an intern at a foreign investment firm, and how do their periods of stay differ?
reference: The trainee invited by the Ministry of National Defense applies at the embassy and is granted a stay of up to 1 year initially. The intern at a foreign investment firm applies through Confirmation of Visa Issuance and is granted a stay of up to 6 months. Both get a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
answer: A trainee invited by the Ministry of National Defense applies for a D-4-2 visa through an Embassy application route, whereas an intern at a foreign investment firm applies through a Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application route [1]. The period of stay for the Ministry of National Defense trainee is granted initially for up to 1 year, while the period of stay for the intern is granted for up to 6 months [1].

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a research or receive training/education at an organization, company, or academic institution except an academic institution equivalent to high school or below, or a language institution affiliated with a foreign academic institution in ROK or at a tertiary education center established in accordance with the Higher Education Act

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A consigned trainees invited by the Ministry of National Defense

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter issued by the Ministry of National Defense

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

- A person who plans to practice skills/techniques at a public research institute or a public training center
- A person who plans to engage in on-the-job training or research as an intern at a foreign investment firm or a company invested in a foreign country

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format

⑥ Household register booklet including every family member and their Chinese ID Card (only for Chinese)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.

question: If the group leader changes after a group e-visa application is complete, what must happen and what condition must the new leader meet?
reference: The change must be corrected immediately, or a request made to the head of the Seoul Immigration Office to correct it, and the new group leader must hold a valid visa of the Republic of Korea.
answer: If the group leader changes after a group e-Visa application is complete, it must be immediately corrected or a request must be made to the head of Seoul Immigration Office to correct it [1]. The new group leader must hold a valid visa of the Republic of Korea [1].

passages.title: Visa guide: C-3-2 Group Tourist
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person or group who plans to visit Korea for travel, or for small-scale cross border trading, guaranteed by an applicant''s travel agency

## E-visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

part of a tour group who gets your visa through a travel agency designated by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad and approved by the Minister of Justice.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form, a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Reference letter of designated travel agency

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days.
The visa holder is not eligible to change the duration or apply for an extension during his/her stay in ROK.

question: A Chinese national entered Korea on March 10, 2016 with a long-term visa that was granted in February 2016. At what point do they have to submit the TB certificate?
reference: When applying for alien registration.
answer: A Chinese national who entered Korea on March 10, 2016, with a long-term visa granted before that date must submit the TB certificate when applying for alien registration [1]. This requirement applies because the individual is a national of a high TB-burden country (China) and entered after March 2, 2016 [1]. The submission deadline is tied to the specific action of applying for alien registration rather than a fixed date [1].

question: im from mongolia on a short term visa in korea and just want to extend my short stay a bit, do i need the tb certificate for that?
reference: No. Short-term status holders who apply to extend their short-term stay are exempt from submitting the TB certificate.
answer: No, you are exempt from submitting the TB test certificate because Mongolia is listed as a high TB-burden country and your exemption applies to nationals of such countries who already submitted the certificate when applying for alien registration on March 2, 2016 or after [2].

passages.title: Visa guide: C-4 Short-Term Employee
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to visit for a short-term employment such as temporary show, advertising·modeling, lecturing·speeching, research, technology consulting, etc.

## Embassy visa application
### Embassy visa application — Case 3

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a language instructor at an English camp for less than 90 days.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document verifying your degree (Choose one below)
- A copy of degree certificate (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
- A degree issued by a respective university (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
- A graduate certificate with degree conferred (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
※ If the document is issued from a country that is not a signatory country of the Apostille Convention, the document can be confirmed by a consulate of a respective country’s diplomatic mission in ROK.
③ Criminal Records (authenticated by the Apostille Convention or consul of Korean diplomatic missions abroad)
④ Employment Contract
⑤ A copy of Business Registration Certificate, a certified copy of Corporate Register or a document demonstrating the establishment of academic institutes
⑥ A certificate of continuing education registration or a document of report, receipt or designation regarding continuing education registration
⑦ Course or class schedule (indicate the hours of participation

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

## Embassy visa application
### Embassy visa application — Case 4

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who is applicable for a Professor(E-1) visa or a Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa, and plans to give a lecture, give public speeches, or research for less than 90 days on the basis of a contract for profits as an expert in a particular area or a university instructor
※ If the lecturer or speaker is not compensated other than flight and accommodation, he/she is eligible for a Short-term General (C-3-1) visa.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An employment contract (on providing lectures·public speeches) or an invitation card that indicates lecture fees and others (a document of request for visa issuance cooperation)
③ A copy of degree certificate and proof of employment
④ A document related to the establishment of an inviting academic institution (a copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of unabridged Corporate Register and others)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 months under the Visa Exemption Agreement between two countries.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: Under which article of the Immigration Act can someone be deported for giving false information on the marriage personal details form?
reference: Article 46 of the Immigration Act.
answer: Someone can be deported for giving false information on the marriage personal details form under Article 46 of the Immigration Act [1]. This applies even if the person has been issued a visa and subsequently admitted to the Republic of Korea [2]. The deportation is based on proving false or misleading information on the form [3].

passages.snippet:
<붙임2>
(제1쪽 / Page1)
결혼 배경 진술서 (Personal Details Form for F-2-3 Visa)
<유의사항>
이 질문지는 영주자격 소지자의 배우자(F-2-3) 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 신청하는 신청인이 작성합니다. 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 신청인께서는 가능한 모든 질문에 답변하고, 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사 시 참고할 수 있도록 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다. 답변이 누락되거나 입증서류가 제출되지 않는 경 우 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
만약 허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건입증에 필요한 서류를 갖추지 못하였음에도 요건을 충족한 것으로 보이기 위해 허위의 사실을 기재하거나 위조된 서류를 제출하는 것은 관련 법령에 의거 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입국이 금지될 수 있습니다.
요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류를 갖추지 못하였다면, 그 사유를 기재한 사유서를 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.
귀하가 제공하신 정보는 개인정보 보호법에 따라 보호되며, 다른 법령에 근거가 없는 한 출입국관리법에 따른 업무에만 활용됩니다.
<NOTE>
This form is to be completed by a person applying for a marriage visa(F-2-3). In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form. Therefore, the questions must be answered to the best of the applicant's knowledge and submit any relevant documentation that can be provided to the consul or the immigration officer as reference. If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the evaluation process for the application may be delayed or disapproved.
If conditions are not met for the visa or if falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant Act but also banned from entering the Republic of Korea. If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason.
The information you provide in this form will be protected according to the Personal Information Protection Law, and will only be used for matters governed by the Immigration Act. 1. 인적사항 / PERSONAL INFORMATION
1.1 여권에 기재된 성명 / Your full name (as shown in your passport)
성 / Famliy name 명 / Given name
1.2 성별 / Sex [ ] 남 / Male [ ] 여 / Female
1.3 현지 언어로 성명을 기재하시오 / Your full name written in your native language 성 / Famliy name 명 / Given name
1.4 과거에 다른 이름을 사용하였던 적이 있습니까?(있다면 그 이름과 변경한 이유를 기재하시오 / Do you have other names you have been known by?(If yes, write the names and explain why you changed the names)

passages.snippet:
< NOTICE 주의사항 >
1. If you receive an e-Visa, you will not have to apply for a visa at a Korean diplomatic mission.
전자사증을 받은 자는 대한민국 재외공관에 사증발급을 신청할 필요가 없습니다.
2. You may present this document when you are asked for Korean visa verification, and you must present it to a Korean Immigration officer at a port of entry. If you do not bring the document with you, you will need to explain your reason(s) to the immigration officer.
이 확인서는 대한민국 사증발급 여부를 확인받기 위하여 제시할 수 있으며, 대한민국 입국 시 입국심사관에게 제시하여야 합니다. 확인서를 소지 하지 않고 입국하는 경우 그 사유를 입국심사관에게 설명하시기 바랍니다.
3. If you receive an e-Visa, you must enter the Republic of Korea before its expiry date. Please note, however, even if you have the e-Visa, you may be denied entry to the ROK during immigration clearance at the port of entry.
전자사증을 받은 자는 이 확인서 상의 입국만료일 이전에 출입국관리공무원의 입국심사를 받은 후 대한민국에 입국할 수 있습니다. 다만, 전자사증을 발급받았더라도 입국심사 과정에서 대한민국 입국이 불허될 수 있음을 알려 드립니다.

question: If my passport is lost or damaged and I get a new one after my Korean visa is approved, what must I do?
reference: You must notify the visa office concerned of the changes in your passport information.
answer: If you receive Korean visa approval and have a new passport issued due to loss or damage, you must notify the concerned visa office of the changes in your passport information [2].

citations.snippet:
1. 위 기재사항과 관련하여 자세한 내용은 별지로 작성하거나 관련 서류를 추가로 제출할 수 있습니다.
If extra space is needed to complete any item, record on a separate sheet of paper or submit relevant documents which could support the application.
2. 대한민국 사증을 승인받은 후 분실 또는 훼손 등의 사유로 여권을 새로 발급받은 경우에는, 정확한 개인정보를 반영 할 수 있도록 변경된 여권정보를 사증처리기관에 통보해야 합니다.
If you received Korean visa approval, and have new passport issued thereafter in lieu of lost/damaged passport, you must notify the concerned visa office of changes in your passport information.
3. 사증을 발급받았더라도 대한민국 입국 시 입국거부 사유가 발견될 경우에는 대한민국으로의 입국이 허가되지 않을 수 있습니다. Possession of a visa does not entitle the bearer to enter the Republic of Korea upon arrival at the port of entry if he/she is found inadmissible.
4. 「출입국관리법 시행규칙」 제9조제1항에 따라 C 계열 사증소지자는 입국 후에 체류자격을 변경할 수 없습니다. Please note that category C visa holders are not able to change their status of stay after their entry into

3. 外国人即使持有有效的韩国签证，经入境查验发现不符合入境条件情形仍有可能被拒绝入境。 Possession of a visa does not entitle the bearer to enter the Republic of Korea upon arrival at the port of entry if he/she is found inadmissible.
4. 根据大韩民国《出入国管理法施行规则》第9条第1款规定，外国人持韩国C类签证入境后不能更改滞留资格种类。 Please note that category C visa holders are not able to change their status of stay after their entry into the Republic of Korea in accordance with Article 9(1) of the Enforcement Regulations of the Immigration Act.

passages.title: Visa guide: D-10-1 Job Seeker
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a training or find a job in a field qualified for a visa of Professor(E-1), Foreign Language Instructor(E-2), Research(E-3), Technical Instructor/Technician(E-4), Professional(E-5), Artist/Athlete(E-6), and Foreign National of Special Ability(E-7)
- The activities not only include a job seeking or on-the-job training (including short-term paid internship) at an organization or company in ROK
* The activities related to Artist/Athlete(E-6) status only includes pure art or sports, and excludes adult entertainment businesses.

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

① A previous employee of a listed company on the Fortune's Global 500 companies for more than 1 year in recent 3 years
② A graduate of a university listed on the Times' Higher World University Rankings in recent 3 years
③ A graduate of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years
④ A person having a bachelor’s degree or above, completed a research program at a Korean research institution in recent 3 years.
⑤ Others who are specially acknowledged by the head of diplomatic mission

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case ① : Certificate of employment history (Proof of Employment), plan for seeking employment
Case ② : Proof of Education*, plan for seeking employment
* Degree (or a document confirming that you will receive a degree in the future), Certificate of Education, Certificate of your degree (Please choose one)
Case ③ : Proof of education and Transcript, plan for seeking employment
* If a proof of education in Korea can be verified via our system (International student Information System), you are exempt from submitting these documents.
Case ④ : Education Certificate, Completion Certificate*, plan for seeking employment
* A certificate indicating research topic, research period, completion results, which is issued by the head of research institution
Case ⑤ : Documents proving that you are a talent*, plan for seeking employment
* Proof of Education, career certificate, recommendation from the respective group or any other proving documents (if you have been awarded or covered by the media for winning a respected international or domestic competition)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: How much does it cost to have an apostille issued in South Korea?
reference: Not in the corpus. The apostille authority list names Korea's competent authorities (the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, the Ministry of Justice and the National Court Administration) but gives no fee for Korea.
answer: The provided passages do not contain information about the cost of issuing an apostille in South Korea; they list fees for various other countries such as Sweden, Hungary, Colombia, Germany, Hong Kong, and New Zealand [1][2][3][4][5][6].

question: What fine does a D-10 job seeker pay if caught working illegally while looking for a job?
reference: Not in the corpus. The Plan for Seeking Employment form only says that people who work illegally while seeking jobs will be punished, without stating a fine.
answer: The passages state that persons who have violated applicable laws and regulations by illegally working while seeking jobs are supposed to be punished [1], but they do not specify the fine amount. The figure in won is not stated.

passages.title: Visa guide: D-10-1 Job Seeker
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a training or find a job in a field qualified for a visa of Professor(E-1), Foreign Language Instructor(E-2), Research(E-3), Technical Instructor/Technician(E-4), Professional(E-5), Artist/Athlete(E-6), and Foreign National of Special Ability(E-7)
- The activities not only include a job seeking or on-the-job training (including short-term paid internship) at an organization or company in ROK
* The activities related to Artist/Athlete(E-6) status only includes pure art or sports, and excludes adult entertainment businesses.

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

① A previous employee of a listed company on the Fortune's Global 500 companies for more than 1 year in recent 3 years
② A graduate of a university listed on the Times' Higher World University Rankings in recent 3 years
③ A graduate of a Korean community college or higher in recent 3 years
④ A person having a bachelor’s degree or above, completed a research program at a Korean research institution in recent 3 years.
⑤ Others who are specially acknowledged by the head of diplomatic mission

### Required documents
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case ① : Certificate of employment history (Proof of Employment), plan for seeking employment
Case ② : Proof of Education*, plan for seeking employment
* Degree (or a document confirming that you will receive a degree in the future), Certificate of Education, Certificate of your degree (Please choose one)
Case ③ : Proof of education and Transcript, plan for seeking employment
* If a proof of education in Korea can be verified via our system (International student Information System), you are exempt from submitting these documents.
Case ④ : Education Certificate, Completion Certificate*, plan for seeking employment
* A certificate indicating research topic, research period, completion results, which is issued by the head of research institution
Case ⑤ : Documents proving that you are a talent*, plan for seeking employment
* Proof of Education, career certificate, recommendation from the respective group or any other proving documents (if you have been awarded or covered by the media for winning a respected international or domestic competition)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

question: I had hepatitis A a few years ago. Will that get my E-2 visa refused?
reference: Not in the corpus. The E-2 applicant's health statement asks whether you have had infectious diseases such as viral hepatitis A, but does not say how a past infection affects the visa decision.
answer: Passage [1] states that applicants must truthfully fill in blanks regarding infectious diseases such as Viral hepatitis A on the Self Health Assessment Report for E-2 applicants, and willful incorrect information can lead to visa denial, cancellation, or deportation [1]. However, passage [1] does not specify whether a past history of Hepatitis A automatically results in refusal if reported truthfully.

passages.title: Visa guide: E-6-2 Hotel and Adult Entertainment
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in performance or entertainment activities at hotel business facilities and adult entertainment facilities in accordance with Tourism Promotion Acts. (Any form of activities such as music, fine arts, and literature, professional acting, or professional entertainment in accordance with the Public Performance Act are not included.)

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to perform or engage in entertainment activities in a hotel or an adult entertainment business defined in the Tourism Promotion Act. (i.e. a pop musician, instrument player, circus artists or magician)

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate
③ A copy of employment contract
④ A performance recommendation letter from the Korea Media Rating Board
⑤ An outline for entertainment activities
⑥ A certificate of qualification or a certificate of employment history
⑦ A letter of guarantee

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

Except for countries not permitted to enter without a visa as announced by the Minister of Justice according to the Special Act on The Establishment of Jeju Special Self-governing Province And The Development of Free International City, foreign nationals entering ports and airports in Jeju for the purpose of Tourism/Transit, etc. are allowed to enter without a visa.

Visa free countries are designated based on international conventions, principle of reciprocity and national interests. (45 countries as of 2022.10.01)

question: How much money must an ordinary D-2-2 bachelor's degree applicant (Case 1, not a Ministry of National Defense consigned student) prove they have when applying at an embassy?
reference: Enough to cover one year's tuition fee and one year's living expenses, shown with an original document.
answer: An ordinary D-2-2 bachelor's degree applicant must prove financial ability to support themselves for one-year tuition fee and living expenses for a year [1]. The specific amount in won is not stated in the passages.

citations.title: Visa guide: D-2-2 Bachelor's Degree
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to enroll for a bachelor's degree in a college, undergraduate/graduate college established in accordance with Higher Education Act, or a college established in accordance with the Special Act

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who plans to enroll for education of bachelor's degree at an academic research institute, or a community college or above, established in accordance with the Higher Education Act or Special Act

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate (or Registration Number Certificate) of a respective education institute
③ Standard Acceptance Letter* (issued by the dean/president of the university)
* For scholarship students invited by the National Institute for International Education, an invitation letter issued by the director can be a replacement
④ Original copy of document indicating the final level of education
⑤ Original copy of document proving your financial ability to support yourself (one-year tuition fee and the living expenses for a year)
- When submitting a parent's bank statement, family relation certificate is required to submit.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A consigned student invited by the Ministry of National Defense

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter issued by the Ministry of National Defense

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to receive training at a private academic institute with an outstanding performance

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible for this visa if you are

A person who plans to receive training at an institute established by a company listed on the Korea Stock Exchange or associated with technology vocational institute. citations.title: Visa guide: D-8-3 Unincorporated Enterprise

## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A required professional who plans to engage in the manufacturing·technical or management·administration area of a foreign-invested company run by a Korean National(individual) in accordance with the 「Foreign Investment Promotion Act」

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person whose name is registered as a co-founder of a company run by Korean(individual) after investing in the company in accordance with the Foreign Investment Promotion Act

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A Foreign Investment Notification form or A copy of Certificate of FDI Company Registration
③ Usage statement of start up capitals from Korean co-founder.
④ Original copy of Business Partnership Agreement and A copy of Business Registration Certificate on which the name of co-founder is written
⑤ Documents demonstrating a transfer of investment capitals
Case A. Investment in Cash
- A permission of a foreign currency transfer, or a confirmation of foreign currency remittance issued by the respective customs service or a bank (or a financial institution) of a respective country
- A statement of investment funds such as a confirmation of foreign currency transfer, a certificate of purchased foreign currency, a customs declaration form and others
Case B. Investment in Kind
- A copy of Confirmation of Completion of In-Kind Investment issued by the head of Korean Customs Service
- A copy of Customs Import Declaration Certificate
⑥ Additional documents for private investors who has invested less than 300 million KRW
- Documents demonstrating an initial capital such as a receipt for the purchased goods, costs of office interior, a bank statement
- Documents verifying the existence of business (i.e. an office lease contract, photos of an office in a front and an inside view, a street sign of a company or others)
- Documents proving work or entrepreneurial experiences from an applicant’s country.
※ Private investors who have invested less than 300 million KRW and have no entrepreneurial experiences will be closely reviewed.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 1 year.

question: i taught english in korea on E-2 and already gave them an apostilled criminal record. i left 2 months ago and want to come back on E-2-1, do i need a new criminal record?
reference: No. If you have previously submitted an authenticated criminal record, stayed in and left Korea, and re-apply within 3 months of your last departure, you are exempt from submitting it.
answer: No, you are exempt from submitting a new criminal record because you have already submitted an authenticated one and your re-application is within 3 months of your last departure from ROK [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: E-2-1 Foreign Language Instructor (General)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who meets the qualifications determined by the Minister of Justice, and plans to teach conversational language at a foreign language institute, affiliated- language research institute or educational institute of higher than elementary school, or language training institute affiliated with an enterprise or broadcasting company, or other equivalent organization.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

1. An instructor at an English Academy
- A person who teaches a foreign language in accordance with Article 3(3) of the presidential decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Private Teaching Institutes and Extracurricular Lessons
2. An instructor who is recruited/selected by an academic institution such as elementary school (or higher) or an affiliated language center
3. A foreign language instructor at corporate language centers for employee on-the-job-training
4. A foreign language instructor at a continuing education institute in accordance with the Lifelong Education Act
* School affiliated continuing education facilities, school·company's internal college·cyber university, business places· civil society groups· media affiliated continuing education facilities, continuing education related to knowledge·human resource development
5. A foreign language instructor teaching at a continuing education facility that is established and run by the state or other local governments in accordance with other laws (including regulations)
6. A foreign language instructor teaching at a vocational skills development facility or vocational training corporation established in accordance with the Workers Vocational Skills Development Act
7. A foreign language instructor teaching at a corporation or a public institute* which has set up a language center that has all the necessary equipment and facilities to study a foreign language for its employees

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A proof of an applicant's education authenticated by a public authority*.
Please, choose one from below to submit;
A copy of a degree, a copy of diploma, a graduation certificate indicating an acquisition of a degree
*The document needs to be authenticated by the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by an official public institute in Korea (i.e. Korean Council for University Education), or by a government agency of applicants(Japanese only)
- If you have a degree from a university in ROK, an un-authenticated copy of a degree will also be accepted.
- If you have a history of submitting a document authenticated by the institutes listed above, you are exempt from the requirement.
③ A criminal record issued and authenticated by a public authority* in an applicant's country
* The document needs to be authenticated under the Hague Apostille Convention(for a signatory of the convention), by consular officers of a Korean diplomatic mission abroad (for not a signatory of the convention), or by consular officers of a foreign embassy in Korea (for a foreign resident in Korea)
- The criminal records that includes all criminal records across the country, must be issued within 6 months from the application date.
- If you have a history of submitting a criminal record authenticated by a public authority, staying and leaving ROK, and re-apply within 3 months from the last departure from ROK, you are exempt from submitting the document. However, if it has been more than 3 months since the last departure, you need to re-submit it when applying for an alien registration.
④ A Self-Assessment Report on Heath
⑤ An employment contract, and a document of the establishment of an academic institute or an organization
⑥ Other necessary documents for evaluation
- an outline of teachers management, a document suggesting the total number of students and faculties

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 2 years.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 2 years.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to work for a sojourner of an outstanding specialist as a household assistant under contract with him/her

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A household assistant of a professional labor who has acquired status of stay of Long-term News Coverage(D-5), Supervisory Intra Company Transfer(D-7) , Int'l Trade(D-9), Professor(E-1), Foreign Language Instructor(E-2), Researcher(E-3), Technical Instructor/Technician(E-4), Professional (E-5), Artist · Athlete(E-6) and Foreign National with Special Ability(E-7)

※ The person must have been employed for at least 1 year by the same employer in other countries.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document proving the income status of the employer
- A receipt for earned income tax withholding, certificate of income amount, payslip, a copy of an applicant's bankbook
※ The employer's income should be three times more than gross national income (GNI) of the previous year announced by the Bank of Korea
③ An employment contract of household assistant
④ A proof of employment of an employer (ID card of employer)
⑤ A letter of guarantee
⑥ A document proving a level of education of the household employee
⑦ A document proving that the household assistant has been hired by the employer for at least one year
※ e.g. employment contract, payslip, a copy of bankbook
⑧ A document proving you have child under the age 13, or you need a household assistant because your spouse has a medical issues or is employed.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.

question: At an embassy, what initial period of stay does an F-3-1 dependent get if the principal is a D-8 investor in a Free Economic Zone, compared with the dependent of an ordinary D-1 to E-7 visa holder?
reference: Dependents of a D-8 investor in a Free Economic Zone (Case 2) get an initial stay of up to 2 years; dependents of other D-1 to E-7 holders (Case 1) get an initial stay of up to 1 year.
answer: For a dependent family member of a Corporate/Foreign Investor (D-8) visa holder who has invested in a Free Economic Zone, the initial period of stay is up to 2 years [1]. For a dependent family member of a Korean Arts and Culture (D-1), Student (D-2), General Trainee (D-4), Long-term News Coverage (D-5), Religious Worker (D-6), Intra-Company Transferee (D-7), International Trade (D-9), Job Seeker (D-10), Professor (E-1), Foreign Language Instructor (E-2), Researcher (E-3), Technology Instructor/Technician (E-4), Professional (E-5), Artist/Athlete (E-6), or Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) visa holder, the initial period of stay is up to 1 year [1].

question: What documents are required for an F-5-5 big investor visa at an embassy?

answer: The required documents for an F-5-5 big investor visa at an embassy are: 1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, and fee [1]. Receipts for Earned Income Tax Withholding (issued by a Tax Office) of at least 5 Korean employees or Certificate of Income Amount (issued by a Tax Office) [1]. The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if deemed necessary for visa evaluation [1].

question: What must a real estate immigrant investor do to extend their period of stay, and what happens if they don't?
reference: They must come to Korea and get an extension from an immigration office before their visa expires; otherwise their alien registration will be cancelled.
answer: To extend their period of stay, a real estate immigrant investor must come to Korea and get an extension from an immigration office before their visa expires [1]. If they fail to do this, their alien registration will be cancelled and they will not be able to continue their stay in Korea [1].

citations.title: Korea Investment Immigration Center Real Estate Investor Scheme Guide
citations.snippet:
Investment Guide for Investors for the Real Estate Immigrant Investor Scheme This guide outlines relevant details for investors for the Immigrant Investor Scheme for Real Estate.
A. (Maintaining Investment Status) Please be warned that your status will be cancelled if you lease or sold the estate, or if your estate becomes foreclosed or is set up for mortgage.
* If you, in any case, fail to meet any of the investment requirements during your investment period, your alien registration will be cancelled, and you will not be able to continue your stay in Korea.
B. (Working or Engaging in Economic Activities) When you have an investor visa, you are free to work, study, and involve in economic activities, however, you must not engage in any speculative behavior or sell or work in an industry that hinders public good and custom.
C. (Re-entry Period) If you have done your alien registration already, you must come to Korea at least once within one year from the date of departure, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
D. (Extending the Period of Stay) You must come to Korea and get an extension from an immigration office BEFORE your visa expires, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
E. (Giving a Consent to the Use of Personal Information) Please note that, by laws, all agents who sell their real estate properties to others must check the lease status, mortgage, sale or foreclosure of their individual buyers and report to the Immigration Office every May and November.
F. (Other Remarks) For more information, please check our website at www.visa.go.kr or contact the Korea Investment Immigration Center (☏ 032-740-7888, 7788) and your jurisdictional immigration office.
As a real estate investor, I, (Investor's name), hereby consent that I have read and understood all of the information above, and I will abide by the rules.

Investment Guide for Investors for the Real Estate Immigrant Investor Scheme This guide outlines relevant details for investors for the Immigrant Investor Scheme for Real Estate.
A. (Maintaining Investment Status) Please be warned that your status will be cancelled if you lease or sold the estate, or if your estate becomes foreclosed or is set up for mortgage.
* If you, in any case, fail to meet any of the investment requirements during your investment period, your alien registration will be cancelled, and you will not be able to continue your stay in Korea.
B. (Working or Engaging in Economic Activities) When you have an investor visa, you are free to work, study, and involve in economic activities, however, you must not engage in any speculative behavior or sell or work in an industry that hinders public good and custom.
C. (Re-entry Period) If you have done your alien registration already, you must come to Korea at least once within one year from the date of departure, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
D. (Extending the Period of Stay) You must come to Korea and get an extension from an immigration office BEFORE your visa expires, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
E. (Giving a Consent to the Use of Personal Information) Please note that, by laws, all agents who sell their real estate properties to others must check the lease status, mortgage, sale or foreclosure of their individual buyers and report to the Immigration Office every May and November.
F. (Other Remarks) For more information, please check our website at www.visa.go.kr or contact the Korea Investment Immigration Center (☏ 032-740-7888, 7788) and your jurisdictional immigration office.
As a real estate investor, I, (Investor's name), hereby consent that I have read and understood all of the information above, and I will abide by the rules.

question: What must be attached to an Application for Pre-investigation of Foreign Investor (real estate)?
reference: One copy of an ID card.
answer: To an Application for Pre-investigation of Foreign Investor (real estate), one copy of the applicant's ID card must be attached [1]. One copy of the applicant's ID card must be attached [2].

citations.snippet:
- 9 - 부동산등 자산투자 외국인 사전심사안내 신청서 Application for Pre-investigation of Foreign Investor(Real estate, etc)
신청인 Applicant 성명 Full Name 여권번호(외국인등록번호)
Passport No.(Alien Registration No.)
주소 Address 투자대상 Investment Project 투자시설 Investment Facility 개발업체 또는 분양업체 Development enterprise or Selling-in-lots enterprise 투자시설 소재지 Address of Investment Facility 투자예정 금액 Amount of Planned Investment Money 부동산등 자산투자 외국인에 대한 체류관리지침의 규정에 따라 본인의 체류허가 적합여부에 대하여 사전심사안내를 위와 같이 신청하며, 사후 사정변경 등으로 실제 체류허가 등 결정내용이 사전안내와 다르더라도 이의를 제기하지 않겠습니다.
Following regulations in sojourn administration guidelines of foreign investors, I request the pre-investigation of my sojourn suitability as it is written above, and will never raise objections even if the final decision is different from the result of pre-investigation due to condition changes in future.
Date: 년 YYYY 월 MM 일 DD장 신청인 Applicant :
(서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)
○○○출입국관리사무소장(출장소장) 귀하 To Chief, ○○○Immigration(Branch) Office 첨부 : 신분증사본 1부. (1 copy of ID card)
사 전 심 사 결 과 事先审查结果
□ 적합 / □ 부적합 Approved Disapproved 확인자Confirmer (서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)
유의사항 Matters to be attended to
1. 사전심사안내는 투자금액 등 투자요건을 갖추었을 경우 신청인에 대한 각종 체류허가 등 가능여부에 대하여 사전에 확인해주는 것이며, 실제로 체류허가를 결정하는 것은 아닙니다. Pre-investigation is only for checking possibilities of various sojourn related businesses in advance when the applicant satisfies investment conditions such as investment money. It does not make an actual decision about sojourn related businesses.
2. 사전심사안내를 받은 이후 국내법 위반 및 기타 사정변경 등이 있을 경우 실제 체류허가 등 신청 시에는 사전안내와 다르게 결정될 수 있습니다.
In case of violating domestic laws or other condition changes, your apply for sojourn related businesses can be decided in a different way other than pre-investigation.
210㎜×297㎜[일반용지(2급) 60g/㎡]
[별첨2(영문)]

유의사항 Matters to be attended to
1. 위임하는 사람이 한국에 없는 기간에 작성된 위임장으로는 대리할 수 없습니다.
A letter of attorney that is written while the mandator is out of Korea cannot be used to entrust.
2. 위임장은 작성한 날로부터 30일까지만 유효합니다. A letter of attorney is only valid for 30 days from the day it is written.
3. 다른 사람의 서명 또는 인장의 도용 등으로 허위의 위임장을 작성하여 증명서를 신청 또는 수령한 경우에는 관련 법률에 따라 처벌 받을 수 있습니다. If you apply or receive a certificate by writing a false letter of attorney with a stolen signature or stamp, you can be punished due to related laws.

question: On the visa application form, who counts as a family member when you list family staying in Korea or travelling with you?
reference: The applicant's spouse, children, parents and siblings.
answer: On the visa application form, family members staying in Korea or travelling with the applicant are defined as the spouse, children, parents, and siblings of the applicant [1]. This scope applies to both the section asking if there are any family members staying in Korea [1] and the section asking if the applicant is travelling with any family members [1]. The same definition of family members is used for both questions across all provided passages [2][3][4][5].

question: What can happen to an E-9, E-10 or H-2 applicant if the details on their Health & Mentality Statement are untrue or left out?
reference: Denial of the visa application, cancellation of the visa approval, and/or deportation.
answer: If an E-9, E-10, or H-2 applicant provides untrue details or omits information on their Health & Mentality Statement, they may face consequences such as denial of visa application, cancellation of visa approval, and/or deportation [1].

passages.title: Visa guide: D-4-2 General Trainee (Others)
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to engage in a research or receive training/education at an organization, company, or academic institution except an academic institution equivalent to high school or below, or a language institution affiliated with a foreign academic institution in ROK or at a tertiary education center established in accordance with the Higher Education Act

## Embassy visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A consigned trainees invited by the Ministry of National Defense

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter issued by the Ministry of National Defense

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

- A person who plans to practice skills/techniques at a public research institute or a public training center
- A person who plans to engage in on-the-job training or research as an intern at a foreign investment firm or a company invested in a foreign country

### Required documents
① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
② A document confirming an applicant's training including research activities (i.e. A training course plan which includes schedule or others)
③ A document relevant to the establishment of the training facility
④ A document proving an applicant's financial ability to support an him/herself during the stay
- A cost-payment confirmation if a training facility is paying for an applicant's living expenses
- A bank statement of more than $3,000 on the account, a record of wire-transfer to ROK or currency exchange
⑤ A letter of guarantee(only when the Minister of Justice deems necessary or if you have not proved an applicant's ability to pay for tuition and other living expenses)
⑥ Household register booklet including every family member and their Chinese ID Card (only for Chinese)

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr
