question: Under the re-entry permit exemption reimplemented in April 2022, how long may an F-4 overseas Korean and a holder of a refugee travel document be away and still re-enter without a re-entry permit?
reference: An F-4 holder may re-enter within their authorized period of stay; a refugee travel document holder may re-enter within the validity period of the document.
answer: Under the re-entry permit exemption reimplemented in April 2022, an F-4 overseas Korean may be away for re-entry within the authorized period of stay [1]. A holder of a refugee travel document may be away for re-entry within the validity period of the document [3].

- 1 - Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to changes in COVID response in the nation.
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents)
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19.

- 1 - Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to changes in COVID response in the nation.
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents)
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19.
1. Persons Exempted from Re-entry Permit ▢ Those Exempted from Re-entry Permit ❍ (Registered Foreigners) Diplomat (A-1) through International Agreement
(A-3), Korean Arts and Culture (D-1) through Dependent Family
(F-3), Marriage Migrant (F-6) through Work and Visit (H-2) status holders for Re-entry into the ROK within 1 year from the date of departure

question: Which Asia-Pacific countries or regions were still eligible for visa-free entry to Korea after April 13, 2020?
reference: Guam, New Caledonia and Palau.
answer: The Asia-Pacific countries and regions still eligible for visa-free entry to Korea after April 13, 2020 are Guam, New Caledonia, Palau, United States, Guyana, Monaco, Vatican City State, San Marino, Andorra, Albania, and Slovenia [1].

question: Under the declaration of accommodation scheme, what must registered accommodation businesses do with a short-term foreign guest's information?
reference: They must relay the foreign guest's information (e.g. passport information) via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice.
answer: Registered accommodation facilities must relay information of foreign guests (such as passport information) via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice [1]. This requirement applies to accommodation facilities registered as a lodging business under the Public Health Control Act, tourist accommodation businesses, city home-stay services for foreign tourists, or Hanok experience businesses under the Tourism Promotion Act [1]. A breach of this requirement results in a fine up to KRW 500,000 [1].

citations.title: Introducing declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents
citations.snippet:
Declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents Visit Hi Korea website (www.hikorea.go.kr) or a dedicated website set up for this scheme (www.k-eta.go.kr/trds) for more information.
This schemes aims to minimise social/economic loss and ensure safety of the public by locating short-term residents' accommodation in a timely manner should a communicable disease outbreak or a terrorist attack takes place.
* Alerts are classified into four levels, namely: attention, caution, alert, and serious.
Declaration is required in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "interest" level or higher in line with "Infectious Disease Control And Prevention Act" or in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "caution" level of higher in line with "Act On Counter-terrorism For The Protection Of Citizens And Public Security".
Foreign residents holding short-term visas- B-1(Visa exempted), B-2(Tourism/transit), C-1(Short-term news coverage), C-3(Short-term visit), C-4(Short-term employment)
should present passport or a travel document to the owner of the accommodation facility.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
Accommodation facilities registed as a lodging business in line with Public Health Control Act or tourist accommodation business, city home-stay services for foreign tourists or Hanok experience business in line with Tourism Promotion Act should relay information of foreign guest (e.g. passport information)
via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
went into force as of 10 December 2020 as a measure to prevent the spread of communicable disease in the country

passages.title: Visa guide: D-3-11 Industrial Trainee (FDI)
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to receive a technical training at an industrial entity engaged in overseas direct investment in accordance with the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A production employee of a joint venture or an overseas subsidiary of Korean cooperation that is established in accordance with the employee's country law and has been running for at least 3 months, is deemed to be unable to acquire required skills in his/her country and is required to receive a job training.

[Trainee Requirements]
1. A healthy person aged between 18 and 40
2. More than 3 months of working experience at the Korean subsidiary
3. Acquiring second-level or higher, or score of 50 out of 200 on TOPIK (excluding those who have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Korea, or plan to receive training at the corporation that has signed the pledge to implement Korean language education of 5 hours or more a month as well as dispatches a full-time translator for every 100 trainees)

### Required documents
1. Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format
2. Documents proving an invitee has met requirements for being an industrial trainee
① A copy of Business Registration Certificate of a branch office located in an applicant's country (or a charter)
② Invitee’s Employment Certificate issued by the head of a branch office and a copy of passport.
③ Documents proving sufficiency in Korean
※ if there is a Korean diplomatic mission in an applicant's country, ① and ② need to be authenticated by consular officers
3. A training course plan confirming the details of training schedule. (refer to Archive)
4. A letter of guarantee from inviter
5. Documents proving the host company is a permitted corporation recognized as Foreign Direct Investment Business
- Foreign Direct Investment Declaration (an original document or a copy stamped by a public official)
- when making investment in cash, a receipt or confirmation of wire transfer (an original document or a copy stamped by a bank)
- when making investment in kind, a confirmation of an export permit issued by the customs

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa Extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr

passages.title: Visa guide: C-3-4 Business Visitor (General)
passages.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

Person who plans to engage in commercial activities such as market research, business meetings, consultation, signing a contract, or small-scale international trading or an APEC card holder visiting Korea without a visa

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

a person who plans to stay for a short period of time in ROK for the purposes of market research, liaison works, counseling, signing a contract, or installing/repairing/learning to operate an imported/exported machinery, or other similar reasons

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A document proving the purpose of your business such as a business invitation letter, a copy of Business Registration Certificate or a certified copy of Corporate Register

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months or a double-entry visa valid for 6 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days for a single-entry visa , and 30 days for a double-entry visa.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year,
if you have visited the ROK or any OECD member country for one time and with no criminal and illegal immigration records

□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, if you are
1) A professional that requires a license recognized by a government such as doctor, lawyer, accountant, and others.
2) A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor at university (or vocational college), a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
3) Famous artists, entertainers and athletes acknowledged by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad
4) A person who has visited ROK as a group-tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in group tourists
* It refers to a tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in only assisting group tourists assembled by a designated travel agency only in contrast to a tourist guide of a group tourist agency in general.
5) A person who has visited the ROK or OECD member countries more than two times and has no criminal or illegal immigration records. (*Entry based on visa exemption or as a group tourist to Jeju is NOT counted as the number of visit to ROK)
6) A person who has visited the ROK with a Medical Tourist visa
7) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, or business ownership worth more than 5,000,000 yuan
8) A public/civil servant of China
9) An executive or an employee of a corporate which has invested more than $1,000,000 (or approximately 1,000,000,000 KRW) in the Republic of Korea
10) An executive or an employee of an airline or a shipping company providing services to the ROK
11) A VIP customer of an internationally-accepted credit card company with the granted level above Gold-Card
12) A person whose monthly income is more than 5,000 yuan (or an annual income of 60,000 yuan)
13) A retiree aged 55 or older who has collected his/her pension
14) An elementary, middle, or high school student, or a student, or a graduate from the listed universities on the 211 project
* Please check the website at http://www.moe.edu.cn/edoas/website18/51/info1207097171157851.htm
15) An employee or manager (or higher) who has been working for more than 6 months at a listed company from the 500 major corporations selected by Chinese Company Association
* Please check the website http://www.cec-ceda.org.cn
16) A person who has purchased a membership card (worth more than 30,000,000 KRW) of a condominium located in Korea*
* verified through a certificate of tax payment of acquisition
17) Parents, Parents-In-Law, Unmarried Child*, Spouse of a valid multiple-entry C-3 visa holder
* A person with multiple nationalities must follow the Guidelines of People with Multiple Nationalities except for a multiple-entry C-3-8 visa holder
18) Registered residents of Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen, who possess the new household registration record containing a tamperproof embedded chip * Those who do not have the new household registration record can present their passport, resident identity card, and old household registration record.
19) an executive of a private enterprise whose annual trade with ROK is worth US$30,000 or more, or a person who has worked for a respective company as a full-time employee for more than 2 years.

□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 5 years,
if you have previously received a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years and have no criminal and illegal immigration records.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Two different documents proving your identity and financial ability to support yourself during the stay in ROK

[ Examples of Documents Proving Your Identity and Financial Ability ]
Proof of employment, credit card statement within the past 6 months, Certificate of Social Insurance Registration, Tax Clearance Certificate, Degree Certificate, Permanent Residence Certificate, Invitation Letter from a specific institution, a document proving that you have collected your pension, proof of employment verifying you have worked as an executive member or a full-time employee at a respective company, records of international trade with ROK

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
A multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year, 3 years, or 5 years will be issued to an eligible applicant.
Period of stay for this visa will be granted for up to 30 days.

## E-visa application

### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

A person who has been invited by the local company(inviter) for commercial purpose, with history of entering Korea for more than 3 times as short-term visitor(C-3) visa since Jan. 1st, 2012.
※ She/he must not have any history of illegal stay or criminal case during the period of stay.

### Required documents
① Visa Application Form, a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② An Invitation Letter including the purpose of an invitation and an agreement that guarantees the return of a patient
③ A copy of ID Card of an inviting person

※ If a representative is hired, he/she must submit a Power of Attorney from an applicant, his/her employment certificate and A copy of ID Card.
※ The head of Immigration Office may request for additional documents if it is deemed necessary to review the purpose of entry, validity of an invitation, and qualification of an inviting organization or an invitee.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay will be granted for up to 90 days.

question: on the corona health condition report form what do i tick if i didnt have any of the symptoms in the last 2 weeks?
reference: Mark the "No Symptoms" box.
answer: On the Health Condition Report Form, if you did not have any of the symptoms in the last 14 days, you should mark the "No Symptoms" box [1]. The form asks you to check symptoms experienced in the last 14 days prior to application [1]. If none of the symptoms apply, you must mark the "No Symptoms" option on the right side [1].

question: How long can I stay in Korea per visit on a C-3-8 short-term visa for overseas Koreans?
reference: Not in the corpus. The C-3-8 page only says it is for overseas Koreans with foreign nationality below age 60, with no period of stay.
answer: On a C-3-8 short-term visa for overseas Koreans, the period of stay is less than 90 days [2]. The form distinguishes between long-term stays over 90 days and short-term stays of 90 days or less [2].

You travel in direct airside transit through the Republic of Korea to visit a country of origin or a third country.

question: Is there a maximum age for a child applying for a D-4-3 elementary, middle or high school student visa?
reference: Not in the corpus. The D-4-3 page covers students at schools at high-school level or below but sets no age limit.
answer: The provided passage does not state a maximum age limit for children applying for a D-4-3 student visa. The eligibility criteria focus on being an international student invited to study on a full scholarship or having a designated guardian, along with acceptance to an eligible educational organization [1].

citations.title: Visa guide: D-4-3 Student (Elementary, Middle, High School)
citations.snippet:
## Overview (eligible applicants / activities)

A person who plans to study at an academic institution equivalent to high school or below

## Embassy visa application

### Embassy visa application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An international student invited to study in Korea on a full scholarship offered by an organization, who has been accepted to an educational organization and is planning to enroll in the school

Eligible educational organizations are
Elementary school, middle school, high school or Foreigner school in accordance with the 「Elementary and Secondary Education Act」, or Foreign educational institution in accordance with the「Special Act on Establishment and Management of Foreign Educational Institutions in Free Economic Zones and Jeju International City」.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate (or Registration Number Certificate) of a respective education institute
③ Acceptance Letter (issued by the President of School)
④ Documents demonstrating the highest level of your education (Graduation Certificate or Proof of Enrollment and etc.)
⑤ Documents proving a full scholarship student(official documents issued by organization or groups)
⑥ In case the inviting group such as corporation, financial ability certification in need
- Guardianship warranty
- Verifying document of the inviting group’s financial soundness such as copy of corporate registration

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.

### Embassy visa application — Case 2

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

An international student having a designated guardian and has been accepted to an educational organization and is planning to enroll in the school

Eligible educational organizations are
Elementary school, middle school, high school or Foreigner school in accordance with the 「Elementary and Secondary Education Act」, or Foreign educational institution in accordance with the「Special Act on Establishment and Management of Foreign Educational Institutions in Free Economic Zones and Jeju International City」.

#### Required documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② A copy of Business Registration Certificate (or Registration Number Certificate) of a respective education institute
③ Acceptance Letter (issued by the President of School)
④ Documents demonstrating the highest level of your education (Graduation Certificate or Proof of Enrollment and etc.)
⑤ Any documents that can confirm your tuition payments (official documents or admission letters of the school confirming course fees, admission fees, and residence fees)
⑥ Documents proving living expenses (Tuition Fee , 1 year living expenses)
- Tuition Fee (including course fee, housing fee, admission fee for studying)
- Annual living expenses (money that has been deposited for a month or more and that is more than the standard amount, bank account bank statement or bank statement and etc.)
⑦ Guardianship warranty
* A written statement of Guardianship must be submitted even if the guardian of a student is a parent, or a family member closer than second degree with a student.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

#### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 1 year.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.
citations.note: visa.go.kr visa guide page, requirements as shown for applicants from the United States; they can differ by nationality and embassy; fetched 2026-07-28
